subtitle: Lesson 3 · A Real Dockerfile for the Storefront App

code:
FROM node:20.17.0-slim AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
caption: Full devDependencies install, used only to produce dist/ -- discarded after this stage.

code:
FROM node:20.17.0-slim AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
caption: Fresh production-only install; only dist/ carries over from the build stage.
